The 911 Rally Collection

Do you dream of a true rally icon? Now you have the chance to acquire legendary Porsche 911 rally cars with a proven racing history and exceptional performance. Seize the opportunity to bid on a piece of motorsport history through Bidders Highway!
Bidders HighwayMarch 21, 2025 10:00

The Porsche 911 has a long and distinguished history in rallying, where its iconic design and exceptional performance have made it a favorite among drivers and enthusiasts worldwide. From classic race cars to modern rally machines, the 911 continues to dominate both gravel and asphalt. In this exclusive collection, we present three of the most impressive and race-proven Porsche 911 rally cars – each with unique characteristics and a proven track record of delivering top results on the competition stage.

These cars, which have left a lasting mark on motorsport history, are now available for auction exclusively through Bidders Highway – a unique opportunity for collectors and drivers to acquire a piece of rally history.

Porsche 911 RSR (1977)

This 1977 Porsche 911 RSR is one of Europe's most successful asphalt rally cars in the FIA European Historic Rally Championship. With three European Championship titles (2012, 2013, and 2015), it boasts an impressive racing history. Over the years, it has been developed and optimized to dominate the European Championship series, making it one of the fastest cars in its class today and a sought-after icon in historic motorsport.

Built according to FIA 3053 period H1 1972-1975 regulations, the car is race-ready for the FIA European Historic Rally Championship, as well as circuit and hill climb events. Its racing pedigree, technical refinements, and proven competitive ability make it a perfect choice for both active racers and collectors of classic racing cars.

Porsche 997 GT3 Rally

This is an outstanding opportunity to acquire one of Sweden's most unique and high-performance rally cars. This Porsche 997 GT3 Rally is built to win and boasts an impressive track record, including a victory in the Madeira Island Rally Championship in 2016. With its perfect balance of raw power, advanced engineering, and an exceptional driving experience, this is the car for the serious rally driver who demands nothing but the best.

Reportedly, this is the only car of its kind in Sweden, making it an exclusive addition for enthusiasts and collectors. Its unique build and proven performance make it a modern icon in rally racing.

Porsche 991 GT3 RS Rally Car

This unique 2016 Porsche 911 (991.1) GT3 RS has undergone extensive modifications to be adapted for track driving, rally use, and sporty street driving—an authentic Porsche 911 GT3 RS RACER. Built by specialists at Motopark Academy GmbH in Oschersleben, Germany, this car is a true high-performance machine.

Under the hood, it features a 4.0-liter flat-six engine producing 500 hp, paired with a seven-speed dual-clutch transmission (PDK) with paddle shifters. Its advanced engineering and expert modifications make it an outstanding choice for drivers looking for a race-ready experience with uncompromising performance.

These three Porsche 911 rally cars represent the pinnacle of rally racing. From historic champions to modern competition machines, they all contribute to a legendary motorsport tradition. For those seeking a race-ready car with outstanding performance and racing pedigree, these models are an excellent choice.

Now available for auction through Bidders Highway – a unique chance to acquire one of these extraordinary Porsche 911 rally cars.
